items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Quincy [Jones] was the producer. He‟s the one that hired me.

ctx.x: Songbook. Here you‟re credited with the arranger and conductor, instead of director. Here you have two divas of very different styles, very different approaches. But you‟re the arranger and conductor or director on the last two dates.
It might have been two charts. I don‟t know. I only remember one, which was I Love You and Don‟t You Forget it. Quincy [Jones] was the producer. He‟s the one that hired me.
